about: The kit presses ch_open_song makes to walk from the title screen to a loaded song, written from the manual, the plan's probe facts and the plan, and not yet tried on the game. Every item is a press on the virtual kit inside the game; the kit route presses no keys and cannot type, so no step searches. Live step LS-K3 of docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-ch-mcp-in-game-input.md presses them one at a time, corrects this file in a one-file data commit, sets verified to true and settles each unproven mark. menu_tools.py says how a step is read.

steps.name: profile screen
steps.manual: Keyboard and Gamepads: "You need to press Start and select a profile using Strum Up/Down and Green before you can navigate the menus." The plan's probe facts: the kit's Start button opened "Choose a Profile".
steps.guess: Whether PlayerProfileMenu reads active true while that screen is shown is unproven.

steps.name: pick the profile
steps.manual: Keyboard and Gamepads, as in step 1: Green selects the profile.
steps.guess: Green picks the highlighted profile and the main menu shows. MainMenu may already read active under the profile screen, so this word may hold before the profile is picked.

steps.name: main menu item
steps.manual: How to Play: "Once you select your game mode you are then shown your current song list to choose from."
steps.guess: Green picks the highlighted main menu item, guessed to be Quickplay; the manual does not name the item order.

steps.name: pick the selected song
steps.manual: How to Play: "Once you select a song, you are then prompted to select your instrument, the difficulty, and apply modifiers."
steps.guess: Green picks whatever song the list has selected, which may not be the target: the kit cannot type into the search. The plan starts a chosen song with ch_start_song instead (its task T8).

steps.name: ready
steps.manual: How to Play, as in step 4. Neither page names the Ready press.
steps.guess: Green is guessed for Ready, with the player screen's default instrument and difficulty. ch_menu prints both with their words; the plan's LS-K3 pass line needs ProDrums and Expert.

steps.name: song loads
steps.manual: No press: this step waits for the loaded song.
steps.guess: The game loads the song with no further press.
